extension.description: Inline code completion (FIM) and next edit suggestions (NES) for GCMP. Requires the main GCMP extension.
setting.fimCompletion.enabled.descriptio: Enable FIM (Fill In the Middle) suggestion feature.
setting.fimCompletion.debounceMs.descrip: Debounce delay for FIM completion (in milliseconds).
setting.fimCompletion.timeoutMs.descript: Request timeout for FIM completion (in milliseconds).
setting.fimCompletion.circuitBreaker.des: Circuit breaker settings for FIM completion. When requests fail consecutively, the service will be temporarily paused to prevent endless retries.
setting.fimCompletion.circuitBreaker.ena: Enable circuit breaker for FIM completion.
setting.fimCompletion.circuitBreaker.fai: Number of consecutive failures before the circuit breaker opens.
setting.fimCompletion.circuitBreaker.coo: Cooldown period (in seconds) before the circuit breaker attempts to recover.
Model name used for FIM completion
setting.fimCompletion.modelConfig.maxTok: Maximum length returned by FIM completion
setting.nesCompletion.enabled.descriptio: Enable NES (Next Edit Suggestions) suggestion feature.
setting.nesCompletion.debounceMs.descrip: Debounce delay for NES completion (in milliseconds).
setting.nesCompletion.timeoutMs.descript: Request timeout for NES completion (in milliseconds).
setting.nesCompletion.manualOnly.descrip: When enabled, NES completion only responds to manual triggers (Alt+/), not automatic triggers.
setting.nesCompletion.circuitBreaker.des: Circuit breaker settings for NES completion. When requests fail consecutively, the service will be temporarily paused to prevent endless retries.
setting.nesCompletion.circuitBreaker.ena: Enable circuit breaker for NES completion.
setting.nesCompletion.circuitBreaker.fai: Number of consecutive failures before the circuit breaker opens.
setting.nesCompletion.circuitBreaker.coo: Cooldown period (in seconds) before the circuit breaker attempts to recover.
Model name used for NES completion
setting.nesCompletion.modelConfig.maxTok: Maximum length returned by NES completion
setting.modelConfig.proxy.description: Proxy server URL for API requests (optional). Credentials in the URL will be masked in logs. Protocol is optional for host:port values such as 127.0.0.1:7890. Use "noproxy" to bypass both configured and system proxies.
setting.modelConfig.extraBody.descriptio: Additional request body parameters that will be merged into the API request body
